staging_tick.why: Which of the camp pair perceives the staged joiner and the medic first, which one turns on whom and whether its rounds hit are set by the host tick the staging lands on, not by the game (rulings R-L4-s32-1, R-LX-s26-1 and R-LX-s28-2: x10's two RR cells, staged near tick 3390, both drew 0x006D outliving the medic's second burst and killing it; the two RR pre-flight cells of push 210, staged near 3374 and 3934, both drew the medic killing the pair). Each AI's think key is g_CurrentTick + 36 x DcbId (Entity_UpdateInfantryAI @0x4B9948..0x4B9953); perception runs when key & 0x1F is 0, its range staged by (key >> 5) & 3 (@0x4BBE3E..0x4BBEB3: phases 1 and 3 reach 6 units at most) and its threat taken by Entity_FindNearestThreat (the call @0x4BBECC); the aim's pitch error phase is ((key >> 9) + (key >> 2)) & 0x3F (@0x4BC61E..0x4BC623), whose key >> 9 term steps once per 512 ticks, so no staging modulus under 32768 holds it. Both hosts count the tick from the mission start (retail zeroes g_CurrentTick in Game_StartMission on every role, @0x525B9F, and steps it once per main frame, @0x5265B4; ours is World::logic_tick, zeroed and stepped at the same points), so every topology stages at one absolute host tick and the whole key is equal. The pair's DcbIds are their CP04.bms records' +8 words (Entity_SpawnFromBMSRecord @0x40EBC1): 0x0019 (organic 25) 1663 and 0x006D (organic 109) 1664; they stand 4.6 and 4.4 units from the staged joiner and 5.5 and 5.7 from the medic's pose and perceive every 32 ticks, at host tick mod 32 = 4 and 0. A pose that lands on tick t is first seen by tick t + 1's update, so every landing from 32k + 4 to 32k + 31 keeps both first perceptions (0x006D's at 32k + 32, 0x0019's 4 ticks later). 4626 is 32 x 144 + 18, so a staging that lands within 13 ticks of it keeps them at 4640 and 4644 (range phases 1 and 0). The staging follows the prelude, which every earlier revive cell ended between ticks 3374 and 3934 (a 560-tick spread); 4626 sits 692 ticks past the latest, so no cell arrives past it, and the wait for it, 11 to 20 s, stays under the runner's 50 s.
